messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p95 latency spike detected for /v1/generate in us-east-1 — p95 = 1.25s over last 5m (SLO 800ms). Automated routing policy triggered fallback to model variant 'gptx-quant-v2' at 1762345678.

oncall-sre-jun: I’m paged, looking now. Any initial customer-facing impact?

ben-cs: seeing a handful of timeouts from a pilot customer in EU that routes through us-east-1 (they reported increased 502s). Not widespread yet but noticeable.

mira-ml: quick note — 'gptx-quant-v2' was intended for short prompts. It has poor long-context performance; KV cache thrash + CPU stalls. If the router is bouncing to that variant under p95 it could increase tail latency.

alex-eng: logs from the router show repeated reroute decisions every ~30s. Looks like threshold hysteresis is insufficient. Copying snippet: ```
router_decision: {
  triggered_by: "latency_p95",
  threshold_ms: 800,
  backoff: 30s,
  fallback_variant: "gptx-quant-v2"
}
```

ops-bot: action log — automated reroute executed 12 times between 1762345660 and 1762345840.

oncall-sre-jun: ok — hypothesis: p95 crosses 800ms, router falls back -> quant variant slows long requests -> p95 worsens -> router flips back to base model -> oscillation. Need to stop automated flipping.

carla-ops: agree. I'm going to pause the auto-fallback policy for us-east-1 to break the loop. Doing via console now.

ops-bot: command executed: `redwood policy disable --scope region:us-east-1 --policy latency_auto_fallback` (response ok).

mira-ml: thanks. Also recommend pinning affected routes to stable variant for the next 30m: `model: gptx-stable-v1` for routes matching `/v1/generate` with length > 512.

alex-eng: applying a temporary route pin. Patch shown: ```yaml
routes:
  - path: "/v1/generate"
    condition: "context_len > 512"
    model: "gptx-stable-v1"
    ttl: 1800s
```

ops-bot: route update applied.

ben-cs: customer impact check: two tenants reported increased p95 internally but after pin they report requests succeeding again. I'll put a quick note to CS playbook and inform account reps.

carla-ops: handing off to next on-call: @mira-ml will take next 2 hours for follow-up and tuning, then @carla-ops takes remainder of shift.

mira-ml: accepted. I'll run a short canary sim with the real prompt mix and watch p95. If stable, we can re-enable auto-fallback with higher hysteresis/backoff and a variant whitelist.

oncall-sre-jun: collecting timeline and will update incident page. Current mitigation: auto-fallback disabled, affected routes pinned, increased capacity (scaled dedicated pool by +2 GPUs) to reduce queueing.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1762345678. Severity: Sev2.

alex-eng: quick root-cause notes for postmortem: routing policy used raw p95 trigger without duration window or model-compatibility checks; fallback variant not validated for long-requests; hysteresis/backoff too small causing flip-flop.

mira-ml: follow-ups to file: 
- add variant compatibility metadata so router won't choose quantized models for context_len > 512
- change p95 trigger to require sustained breach for 3 consecutive windows
- implement exponential backoff on fallback decisions
- add simulation test that exercises long-context prompts through routing policy

carla-ops: tagging product and devex for docs update and a console knob to temporarily hold auto decisions during incidents.

ben-cs: sent customer-facing note to impacted accounts and flagged follow-up with account teams.

oncall-sre-jun: marking mitigation as successful — p95 back under 800ms for last 6 minutes after pin + scale. Will keep monitoring.

mira-ml: added a metric dashboard panel for "routing decision churn" and a regression alert.

carla-ops: handing off final monitoring to @carla-ops. Please escalate if you see reversion.

carla-ops: (02:12) Thanks all. Incident mitigated for now. Retro ticket: ENG-PR-1429 with owner @alex-eng for policy logic changes.

ops-bot: summary: 1762345678 — Latency-triggered routing flip-flop; automated fallback -> incompatible variant -> oscillation; mitigation = disable auto-fallback, pin stable variant, scale pool, patch policy.

incident-bot: closing notes: next steps assigned. Postmortem requested within 72h. :white_check_mark:
